content:
Although CarPlay supports hundreds of apps, it notably does not include Apple Weather. The good news is that starting today, the iPhone version of The Weather Channel's Storm Radar app officially supports CarPlay.

Storm Radar is one of an increasing number of weather apps that support CarPlay.

The Weather Channel has been working throughout this year to build Storm Radar into a flagship app on the Apple platform.

The iPhone and iPad versions previously added AI-powered forecasting features, followed by the launch of an Apple Watch version.

Today's new update takes things further with a dedicated CarPlay app. Here's a look at the app's interface:

The CarPlay version of Storm Radar includes a map of your current location. You can switch between satellite view and the default map background. Data layers include radar, clouds, and precipitation.

Navigation is also one of the core features of the CarPlay app. Storm Radar displays both your current weather conditions and the predicted weather at your destination along with your estimated time of arrival.

The Weather Channel added that CarPlay support includes "automatic rerouting along the way and weather alerts, which will continue to update while you drive."

Today's Storm Radar update also adds new home screen widgets, a redesigned Apple Watch app, and a number of other changes. For the full changelog of version 4.0.19, visit the App Store.
